notes: Summary: SMB logistics startup building a customer-facing chat assistant for shipment tracking and support. Primary concern = latency for EU customers despite backend hosted in us-east.
Workload: chat-heavy, bursts at morning shipment windows, average session 3-4 turns, typical prompt ~180-450 tokens depending on context.
SLOs: want median latency <300ms for short queries (50-150 tokens), willing to accept 400-600ms for longer responses but unhappy above 1s.
Observed: customers reporting 600-1200ms for 200-350 token prompts; perceived as sluggish vs competitors.

Initial SE triage: network RTT to us-east ~80-180ms from EU, model selection currently small Llama-variant quantized offering higher variance. Key levers: region choice, streaming, timeout config, prompt window, model variant.
Recommended quick wins provided to customer:
- Region: spin up host in eu-west to reduce RTT. Run A/B test (us-east vs eu-west) and capture p50/p95 token latencies.
- Timeouts: client side timeout temporarily set to 7s -> then tune to 5s as streaming enabled; ensure server-side keepalive 30s.
- Prompt guidance: trim system messages, remove long context blobs; prefer dynamic retrieval + short context (200-400 tokens) and use embeddings for long doc lookups.
- Max tokens: cap responses to 320 tokens for chat where possible and design follow-ups instead of very long single responses.
- Streaming: recommended enabling streaming (reduce TTF first-byte perceived latency) and chunk large outputs into multiple events.
- Model selection: test a lower-latency Redwood-verified small model for short Q&A and fallback to larger model for complex reasoning.
Customer quotes: "Users in Germany are noticing the delay — it's hurting CSAT"; "Cost is tight; we need hosted option not Dedicated".
Action items agreed: AE to schedule 30 min perf deep-dive with SE (Maya) and engineering on 2026-03-10; customer will run region tests and share sample request traces and anonymized logs.

Risks/Concerns: customer budget limited for Dedicated; needs clear ROI on latency work. Wants simple checklist they can apply immediately. Worried about token-cost impact of longer prompts and embeddings.
